name: Cherry
houseDescription: Concrete, ironwork, and moody lamps — an urban studio that matches her leather-jacket attitude.
description: Cool big-sister dog with punk style. Cherry is protective, a little tough, and surprisingly sweet once she trusts you.

seo.title: Cherry — Sisterly dog
seo.description: Cool big-sister dog with punk style. Cherry is protective, a little tough, and surprisingly sweet once she trusts you.

acnh.appearance: Cherry is a bold red dog with teal eyes and a gray ring around her left one. Black ears frame a purple nose; white markings on her left ear read like stud earrings. Her torso and legs run black against red arms and tail, with black paws anchoring the look. Six lashes line each eye — three above, three below — and her smile curves slightly to the left even at rest.
acnh.personality: Cherry brings big-sister energy — protective, blunt, and ready with advice whether you asked or not. She treats the player like a younger sibling, offering tips on everything from gifts to island etiquette. Gossip and rumor-mongering rub her wrong; snooty and cranky villagers who trade in that talk get short shrift. Jocks and lazy neighbors fit her easygoing hobbies, and most villagers find her tomboy warmth approachable. She speaks her mind without much filter, but the care underneath is genuine.

villagerInfo.quote: One dog barks at something, the rest bark at him.
